description: A bearded man with dark wavy hair, in scale armour with gold trim and a red cloak, stands at the carved wooden prow of a boat holding a sword. Behind him on the left is a gold-framed icon of a Madonna and child with Greek letters on it, and a crowd of helmeted men. On the right a fleet of sailing galleys moves over dark stormy water toward a walled city with domed towers under a grey sky. The style is oil painting.
